window.title: Two players will respectively lay white discs or black discs one by one. Whoever lays down 5 in a row first is the winner.
1. Players will lay down discs turn by turn. The player with the black discs goes first.
2. Click anywhere on the board and then left click it to lay down disc.
The first one lays 5 discs in a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal row wins.
1."3 Free": 3 discs in a row without rival's block. It's closed to victory if you makes "4 More".
2. "4 more": 4 discs in a row without rival's block. Victory is yours.
3. "Poor 4": 4 discs in a row with one side blocked. You may still win if the rival doesn't notice.
1. move: Move the cursor on the board to choose placement location
2. lay: Left click to lay down a disc.
3. yeild: You can end the present game by clicking yeild.
Big-2 is a popular card game. The biggest number in the game is 2.
There can be 2-4 players playing at the same time. It is simple. You need to play a bigger number card than the last player. Whoever lays out all their cards will be the winner.
1. The player has a club 3 goes first and then others follow counter-clockwise.
2. You should play the same type of cards when it is your turn.
3. Yours must be bigger than the last card.
5. If the number of cards are same, it is according to the type of the cards.
6. type of card order is: Spade >Heart >Diamond >Club
7. If your card is not bigger than your target, you have to give up the game.
1. Single card: According to the number or the type
2. A Pair: Two card of the same number. According to the number or the suit
3. Straight: 5 cards with continual Num. Compare by the biggest card.
4. Full House: 5 cards. [3 cards of same number] & [a pair]. Compare by 3 cards.
5. 4 of a kind. [4 cards of same number] & a [single card]. Compare by 4 cards.
6.Straight Flush: 5 cards of continual num and same tpye. Compare by the biggest card.
1. Choose: Click to raise cards you want, such as the diamond Q in the picture.
2. Cancel: Click the raised card to cancel it. such as Diamond Q in the picture.
3. Play: Click [Play] to play the card you chose, such as in picture A.
4. Pass: Click [Pass] to give up once, such as in picture B.

/c#00F7FF[Card Book Introduction]/c*
 1.Right clicking on a card adds it in card book. The card that is already in the book cannot be added in the book again. 
 2.Pressing [/c#EEFF33Alt+C/c*] opens the card book the view the cards in it. 
 3.A card book includes /c#EEFF33Card Set/c* and /c#EEFF33Card List/c*. /c#EEFF33Cards Set/c* is displayed in order for easy viewing cards and rewards. /c#EEFF33Card list/c* is displaying all cards for searching the needed card easily.
 4.Below the card list is /c#EEFF33the prompt of getting a card /c*and/c#EEFF33 easy instruction of set card/c*.
 
/c#00F7FF[Card Interface Introduction]/c* (Refer to the picture at the right)
 1./c#00F7FFCard number/c*: Each card has an unique number for easy search and taxis.
 2./c#00F7FFCard name/c*: the name of a card.
 3./c#00F7FFStar grade/c*: Star grade tells the card's level, value and the difficulty level to be obtained. /c#EEFF33Star grade colors/c* include /c#EEFF33white/c*,/c#EEFF33 blue/c* and /c#EEFF33golden/c*. Examples: /c#EEFF33...<4 white stars < 5 white stars < 1 blue star < 2 blue stars <...< 5 blue stars < 1 golden star < 2 golden stars <.../c*.
 4./c#00F7FFCard title picture/c*: The card title picture is corresponding to its name.
 5./c#00F7FFCard color/c*: There are four types of cards with four colors corresponding to them. They are: /c#EEFF33Monster/c*->/c#EEFF33red/c*, /c#EEFF33Boss/c*->/c#EEFF33black/c*, /c#EEFF33Scene/c*->/c#EEFF33green/c*, /c#EEFF33Equipment/c*->/c#EEFF33white/c*.
 6./c#00F7FFCard instruction/c*: The brief introduction to the card.
 
/c#00F7FF[Card Set Interface Introduction]/c*
 1.The way to gain rewards: Getting the whole set card. Below are the two ways: /c#EEFF33One of them/c* means one item can be selected from the following items. /c#EEFF33All of them/c* means all the rewards are given to the angels who gathered all the required cards.
 2.[/c#EEFF33Exchange/c*] button: As long as you gather the whole set card, you can press the button to get extra reward. If the rewards are optional, you should select one first.
 3.Rewards for set card: At the bottom of the set card instruction tells the rewards for gathering the whole set card. But the rewards can be gained only once.

/c#00F7FF【天使柏青哥兌獎商店說明】/c*
 1.天使柏青哥兌獎商店內所販售的商品，必須藉由「/c#EEFF33小鋼珠/c*」來進行交易。
 2.可透過商城或柏青哥遊戲購買小鋼珠使用。
 3.小鋼珠無法藉由/c#EEFF33交易/c*或者/c#EEFF33轉讓/c*給其他角色，僅能夠給角色本身使用。

/c#00F7FF【兌獎商店介面操作方法】/c*
 1.點選柏青哥介面右方的/c#EEFF33柏青哥兌獎商店/c*按紐即可開啟介面。
 2.商品陳列分類共分為/c#EEFF33功能類、特殊類、福袋類、寵物類、裝扮機甲、傢俱類/c*。
 3.每次只能以一種商品為單位進行交易。
 4./c#00F7FF購買：/c*挑選商品後，點擊介面下方「/c#EEFF33兌換/c*」按鈕，系統會再次進行確認。再次確定後，將會消耗指 定的小鋼珠，商品將會放置到「/c#EEFF33自己的背包欄位/c*」內，但必須確定身上的/c#EEFF33負重/c*以及多 餘/c#EEFF33空間/c*是否足夠。
